plugins.name: learning-planner
plugins.description: A learning companion skill that helps plan, track, and review self-directed learning journeys in structured phases. Supports natural language interaction (English & Chinese) and generates Obsidian-compatible markdown files with checkbox task tracking, progress summaries, and phase archives. Triggers on phrases like "plan my study", "学习计划", "what should I learn next", "阶段结束", "review my progress".

skills.name: learning-planner
skills.description: Use when the user talks about learning plans, study schedules, or wants to plan/organize/review their learning progress. Triggers on phrases like "学习计划", "规划学习", "下一阶段", "帮我安排", "学完了", "阶段结束", "总结进度", "plan my study", "learning roadmap", "what should I learn next", "review my progress", "course planning", "skill development plan", "arrange my learning", "学习清单", "学习路线", "学习总结", "阶段规划", organize study, study tracker, progress review. Use this skill whenever a user wants to create, update, or complete a structured learning phase WITH checkbox task tracking and progress summarization.
